scope: Independent local source review of the isolated conditional-boundary diagnostic. Source identities, data-flow and cleanup contracts, plus generated Python AST only. No remote submission, model/GPU invocation, actual33-boundary capture, numerical tolerance decision or production modification was performed by this review.

delegated_owner_recipe.semantics: ConditionalBoundaryWorker derives from original ActorRolloutRefWorker and calls the unchanged original inspection method on the same actor. The existing diagnostic callback global is temporarily substituted and restored. Original actor initialization, checkpoint loader, model objects/configuration, seven literal B4 groups, three variants, precision context, attention/training restore and parameter offload remain owner calls.

data_flow_review.conclusion: The original selected_target_log_probs is called once and its exact returned object is returned. The complete original trace_token_attribution owns root, seed and all finite propagation. No public attribute observer is supplied. Native forward prehook records metadata only. Full trace diagnostic includes actual detail and actual signed source probes.

The wrapper first calls the existing _token_effect unchanged. At original seed_effect it copies the actual passed coefficient at boundary32; at original layer input_effect it copies the actual coefficient for boundary i. Only original first-response slot slices are copied through original owner _copy to completed ordinary CPU storage. No coefficient is reconstructed from endpoints or recomputed on CPU. The same original _token_effect return object is returned.

The outer score wrapper invokes the original score once, then reads the original attribute frame root dictionary before the inner old observer raises its score-stop sentinel. Each coefficient contracts original paired rows2slot/2slot+1 from CPU root checkpoint through original _token_effect over the complete suffix. This reuses existing captures and introduces no model forward or new native capture.

Original recipe caller supplies the same group/result metadata. Only source_step0 original slots are retained for comparison, while all four original model rows and all three original variant calls remain. Single coordinates must exactly equal full bank prefix_cut/suffix_length/original_length/logical_batch; coefficient and root slice shapes must match.

Original full branch supplies actual prefix cut; both single variants retain that cut and original numeric MIN callback. Original helper interleaves reference,factual per sample. Every first-response reference row replaces its own sampled token; non-first partners keep their original full-EOS reference and all factual rows remain original.

count_scope_review.count_provenance: The adapter updates the original diagnostic result dict after successful full trace calls; it also overrides the original lightweight return finite0 counters. Main completed metadata reflects full14/seed14. These are source-reviewed counters/schedules, not claims that this review executed those calls.
count_scope_review.timing: Full traces include coefficient CPU copies and original passive scalar ledger; single timers include CPU contractions. The updated timing_scope excludes interpreting these as a production performance comparison.

cleanup_review.collector_globals: Nested _token_effect wrappers restore in context finally; original owner parameters/state are never replaced.
cleanup_review.score_globals: Single nested original-score wrappers restore in their finally blocks; score-stop sentinel remains the original observer control flow.
cleanup_review.bank_lifetime: One group bank is retained across its two single observations, then by_boundary is cleared and state.bank becomes None. Worker finally clears a remaining bank on failure. An incomplete full-trace bank is local and no persistent state reference is installed before success.
cleanup_review.frames_and_activations: Attribute frames, root dictionaries and transient endpoint/coefficient/token-vector locals are explicitly dropped after contraction. Serialized output retains scalar and source/shape metadata, not activation/coefficient tensors. Existing original recipe still owns model cleanup.

only_review_fix.change: Existing two diagnostic dependency checks now record exact remote path/SHA in diagnostic_dependencies and include that field in the original prepared/launch equality comparison. The earlier parent-added receipt-fetch code was preserved. Driver and collector were not edited.
only_review_fix.reason: Prepared/launch receipts previously did not bind the dependency sources already checked by the stager.

CPU_static_checks.execution_note: Only stdlib imports of the staging modules and generation/AST parsing of shell-embedded Python occurred locally. Generated remote code was not executed.

mathematical_scope.object: C_b(i)=sum over whole original cached suffix and hidden dimensions of actual joint M_b for original slot times actual single factual-minus-reference native root H_b.
mathematical_scope.boundaries: 0..31 decoder inputs and32 final norm input; this collector does not capture final-norm output or detailed norm/add/FA/FLA operator operands.
mathematical_scope.native_BF16_limit: The boundary contraction profile contains storage, kernel/backend and joint-condition propagation/allocation effects together. It does not itself separate BF16 storage from conditional approximation; the existing actual-operand owner CPU split remains a separate diagnostic if a measured boundary motivates it. Casting stored BF16 roots to float32 cannot recover precast values.
mathematical_scope.sampling: Original52 transport probe observations→42 unique source tokens from21 successful first-response trajectories; duplicate and G0 scope must remain explicit.43 G0 trajectories are not compared.

limitations: This source review does not assert actual GPU coefficients were captured, all33 boundary callbacks executed, or numerical quality passed.
The old saved DT d is inferred from original FP32 A; the new full trace will record actual live signed d separately.
No official whole-model tolerance, corrective normalization, alternative finite rule, PPO/config/credit change or full historical-causality claim is introduced.

The wrapper reads diagnostic local names and classifier source sites from the explicitly pinned original recipe/runner; source changes require recording/reviewing the new identities, not pretending the existing binding applies.
